stack: Static web app (HTML/JS ES modules), node:test, GitHub Pages

features.name: Increase the number of user by adding…

idea.intent: Travellers planning a trip get a ready-to-use checklist by picking suggestions from the 'Guides' they already read, so more people start and keep using the app for trip planning.
idea.problem: Guides hold useful suggestions (what to prepare, bring, or do), but today a traveller has to retype them into the trip's checklist by hand. That extra work puts people off, and nobody can see whether Guides help people plan, so we can't tell if they bring in or keep users.
users: Traveller / trip owner who builds the trip checklist
Trip members who tick items on the shared checklist
Admin who wants to see whether Guides drive adoption
idea.outcomeMetric: A traveller can add a suggestion from a Guide to a trip's checklist in one step and see it on the checklist straight away. Admin can see how many Guide suggestions travellers add to checklists, so the team can tell whether the feature brings in and keeps users. No target is set yet; one will be agreed after a few weeks of real usage data.
scopeIn: Add a suggestion from a Guide to a chosen trip's checklist
Confirmation when a suggestion is added, and a clear error when it cannot be added
Counting how often Guide suggestions are added to checklists, visible to Admin
scopeOut: Changing how checklists are shared or ticked by trip members
risks: The need says 'increase the number of user', which is unclear. It may mean more app users, or more travellers on a trip. The Product Owner should confirm before design starts.
No success metric or baseline exists yet. Pick one metric and set the target only after a few weeks of real data.
Usage counting must not expose personal data about individual travellers.
Adoption: travellers may not find the 'add to checklist' action inside Guides.
Duplicate items if the same suggestion is added twice to one checklist.
idea.need: Increase the number of user by adding some suggestion from 'Guides' into trip's checklist

design.summary: The design adds one new action to the Guides page, one dialog, and one panel in the existing Admin → Insights. It adds a baseline for every page and a fast Home page. It reuses what the repo already has: `Modal`, `Combobox`, `.btn` and `.field` styles, the `notify` toast, the `Loader` in `ui.jsx`, the `can('<key>')` feature flags in `src/data/flags.js`, and the `insights` permission in `src/lib/roles.js`. The new UI goes behind a flag with `defaultOn: false`, as the agent-knowledge notes require. The checklist item limit is `CHECK_ITEM_MAX` = 120 in `src/lib/checklist.js`. The 'Add to checklist' code loads with the Guides page, so the Home bundle does not grow. I did not read `Modals.jsx`, `Combobox.jsx`, the Guides UI or the Admin Insights UI. Their exact current behaviour (focus trap, focus return, Combobox ARIA, Insights layout) is still to be confirmed.
design.notes:
Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA):
- Text contrast is 4.5:1. Focus ring and icon contrast is 3:1. Touch targets are at least 44x44 px on phones.
- Errors use role=alert and are linked to their field with aria-describedby. Toasts use role=status.
- Every new string exists in VI and EN (`src/i18n.jsx`, `src/i18n-en.js`), including aria-labels and error messages.
- The Insights table uses real headers. The period control works with arrow keys.
- Tests: TC-003 is a keyboard Tab walk plus an axe scan on each page, including Guides, the dialog and Insights. TC-004 is manual: open the dialog, submit with no trip chosen, and confirm the error and that nothing is saved.

Responsive (phone):
- The dialog uses `modal--sm` and the controls stack full-width.
- The bottom nav must not cover the focused field. Scroll the focused element into view.
- The virtual keyboard must not hide the error or the Add button.
- The Insights table scrolls horizontally, or turns into a stacked list on narrow screens.
- The skip link and focus ring must also work with an external keyboard on a tablet.

Open questions:
1. Is the 2.5 s target for the Home page only, or also for Guides? REQ-002 says Home only.
2. Should 'Add to checklist' show only to signed-in users? Creating trips needs a Google sign-in. A signed-out user is sent to sign-in.
3. Which focus-trap and focus-return behaviour does `Modal` already have? It must be confirmed before changing it.
4. Which Guide data has a stable id for each suggestion? REQ-005 needs a suggestion id stored on the item, so a renamed item is still a duplicate. This changes the checklist item shape.
5. How are counts stored, and who can write them? The data must hold only Guide, date and count (REQ-008), so the Firestore rules need checking.
6. The need says 'increase the number of user'. The Product Owner should say whether this means more app users or more trip members. The screens do not change either way.
7. The Figma file was not opened in this run. These screens still need to be drawn in Figma.

screens.name: SCR-1 Keyboard and focus baseline (all pages)
screens.purpose: Every page can be used with the keyboard alone and with a screen reader. This includes the new Guides action, the dialog and the Insights panel.
elements: 'Skip to main content' link: first tab stop, visible only on focus
Landmarks: header/nav, main, and the phone bottom nav with an aria-label
One global :focus-visible ring, at least 3:1 contrast, on buttons, links, icon-buttons, inputs and the Combobox. No outline:none without a replacement
Icon-only controls (✕ ✏️ 🗑️ 📅) have a translated aria-label. The Combobox clear button's hard-coded 'Clear' becomes t()
Custom clickable divs become real <button> or <a>, or get role, tabIndex and Enter/Space handlers
Existing Modal: role=dialog, aria-modal and Escape stay. Focus moves into the dialog on open, stays inside, and returns to the trigger on close
Toasts use role=status / aria-live=polite. Errors use role=alert
Due-today and overdue checklist states also show text or an icon, not colour only
states: Default: no ring on mouse click, ring on keyboard focus
Focused: visible ring on every control
Modal open: focus trapped, Escape closes, focus returns to the opener
Error: message linked to its field with aria-describedby and announced
Reduced motion: animations off under prefers-reduced-motion

screens.name: SCR-2 Home page fast start (4G)
screens.purpose: The Home page is interactive within 2.5 s on 4G (Lighthouse). Nothing heavy loads before it is needed.
elements: Reuse the existing lazy loading for map libraries, country borders, the dictionary and studios
Small critical shell that paints first. Page CSS split per page
Images with width/height set, lazy below the fold
Existing Loader or skeleton for late content, with aria-busy on the region
F-001 add-to-checklist code and the Insights panel load with the Guides page or Admin, not with Home
Check: Lighthouse mobile 4G run on Home
states: Loading: shell and skeleton shown, controls already focusable
Slow or offline: short message with a Retry button, and the rest of the page still works
Error: a failed lazy chunk shows a retry message, not a blank screen

screens.name: SCR-3 Guide suggestion row with 'Add to checklist' action
screens.purpose: The traveller sees the 'Add to checklist' action next to each Guide suggestion without opening a menu. After a successful add, the action shows 'Added'.
elements: Existing Guides page. A real <button class='btn'> sits on every suggestion row, labelled '+ Add to checklist'
Accessible name includes the suggestion text, e.g. aria-label from t('addToChecklistFor', {text}). It is reachable by Tab and works with Enter and Space
'Added' state: ✓ icon plus text, aria-disabled, and an sr-only note naming the trip. Colour is never the only signal
A hint on the first suggestion ('Add to your trip checklist') helps travellers find the action
Behind a feature flag with defaultOn false, wrapped in can('<key>')
VI and EN strings in src/i18n.jsx and src/i18n-en.js
states: Default: button visible on every suggestion
Added: button shows '✓ Added' and the trip name is announced via role=status
Signed out: button opens the sign-in prompt (see open questions)
Guide with no suggestions: no button shown

screens.name: SCR-4 Add suggestion to checklist dialog
screens.purpose: The traveller picks a trip and adds the suggestion in one step. Duplicates are blocked and errors are clear. Nothing is saved on an invalid or failed attempt.
elements: Existing Modal titled 'Add to checklist' (modal--sm on phones)
Read-only line with the suggestion text. Text over 120 characters (CHECK_ITEM_MAX) is shown truncated, with a note that it will be saved as 120 characters
Trip selector: existing Combobox with a visible <label>, listing only trips whose checklist the user can edit. Member-only trips are not offered
Primary 'Add' and secondary 'Cancel' using .btn. Enter submits
Inline error under the trip field with an icon, role=alert and aria-describedby
'Create a trip' action in the no-trip state
On success: a notify() toast naming the trip, and the new unticked item appears on that trip's checklist without a reload. Trip members see it with normal tick behaviour

screens.name: SCR-5 Admin Insights: Guide suggestion adds
screens.purpose: The Admin sees how many Guide suggestions were added to checklists, per period and per Guide, with no personal data.
elements: New panel 'Guide suggestions added' in the existing Admin → Insights module (shown only with the 'insights' permission)
Period selector: segmented control or radio group for last 7 days, last 30 days and all time, with a visible label and arrow-key support
Total count in a large number card
Table of Guide name and number of adds, with proper <th> headers. Guides with 0 adds are listed with 0
Privacy note: 'Counts only. No user or trip is stored'. Any export has only Guide, date and count columns
Only successful adds are counted. Duplicate and failed attempts are not
states: Loading: Loader, aria-busy on the panel
Loaded: total and per-Guide table for the chosen period
Empty: total 0 and every Guide listed with 0, plus a hint that no adds have happened yet
Error: message with a Retry button
No permission: the panel and the count are not rendered and the user sees the existing no-access state

features.name: allow user to filter trip cost by…

idea.intent: Trip members can quickly narrow a trip's cost list to the costs they care about (how it was paid, who it was shared with, what kind of cost), so they can check and reconcile spending without scanning every line.
idea.problem: A trip's cost list shows every cost together. Members cannot easily see only the card or cash payments, only the costs shared with one person, or only one kind of cost such as accommodation, transport or food & drinks. This makes it hard to check spending, work out what a person owes, or review one category. The cost list already records who a cost is shared among (splitAmong) and a cost type (costType, 10 types such as Accommodation and Food & drinks) [S1]. Payment method (card or cash) is not found in the cost data I searched, so it may be a new detail to capture.
users: Trip members who enter and review costs on a shared group trip
Trip owner who checks the group's spending and who owes what
Solo traveller reviewing their own trip costs by category or payment method
idea.outcomeMetric: A user viewing a trip's costs can filter the list by payment method (card, cash), by a specific person the cost is shared with, and by cost type. The list then shows only the matching costs, and the user can clear the filter to see all costs again.
scopeIn: Filter the trip cost list by payment method (card, cash)
Filter the trip cost list by a specific person the cost is shared with
Filter the trip cost list by cost type (accommodation, transport, food & drinks, and the other existing types)
Clear the filter to return to the full list
Show a clear message when no cost matches the filter
Record payment method on a cost, if it is not already captured, so it can be filtered
scopeOut: Changing how costs are split or how balances and settle-up are calculated
New cost types beyond the existing list
Payment methods other than card and cash
Changing Excel or PDF export contents
Saving filters across sessions or sharing them with other members
risks: Payment method may not exist on current costs. Existing costs will be shown as 'Not set' (Product Owner decision). The team needs to confirm that 'Not set' costs do not appear under the card or cash filter.
Open question: should several filters combine (for example card AND food & drinks)? The need does not say.
Open question: should the totals shown change with the filter, and could a filtered total be mistaken for the whole trip's total or for settle-up balances?
'Shared with a specific person' means a cost where the person is in the split. Costs shared by the whole group (empty split) must be treated consistently.
The need says 'travel' while the app's cost types use 'Transport' and 'Flights'. The labels need agreeing.
Cost entry and the filter must work for keyboard and screen-reader users (REQ-002 accessibility baseline).
idea.need: Allow user to  filter trip cost by payment method (card, cash), cost shared a specific person, type of cost (accomdation, travel, foods & drinks, etc)

requirements.title: Accessibility and performance baseline
requirements.story: As an user, I want every page to work with keyboard and screen readers and load quickly, so that everyone can use the product.
ac:
Given any page
When I navigate with the keyboard only
Then every action is reachable and has a visible focus state

Given a 4G connection
When I open the home page
Then it becomes interactive within 2.5 seconds (Lighthouse)

requirements.title: Add a Guide suggestion to a trip checklist in one step
requirements.story: As a traveller who owns a trip, I want to add a suggestion I read in a Guide to my trip's checklist with one action, so that I don't retype it by hand.
ac: Given I view a Guide suggestion and have a trip selected · When I activate 'Add to checklist' once · Then a new unticked checklist item with the suggestion's text appears on that trip's checklist without a page reload

Given the suggestion text is longer than the checklist item limit of 120 characters (CHECK_ITEM_MAX in src/lib/checklist.js) · When I add it · Then the item is saved truncated to 120 characters and the add succeeds
Given I add a suggestion · When trip members open the shared checklist · Then they see the new item with the same tick behaviour as any other item

requirements.title: Choose which trip receives the suggestion
requirements.story: As a traveller with several trips, I want to pick the trip a suggestion goes to, so that it lands on the right checklist.
ac: Given I own two or more trips · When I activate 'Add to checklist' on a suggestion · Then I am asked to choose a trip before anything is saved, and the item is added only to the chosen trip
Given I have no trip yet · When I activate 'Add to checklist' · Then I see a message that I need a trip first with an action to create one, and no item is saved
Given I am only a member (not owner) of a trip and the app does not let me edit that trip's checklist · When the trip list is shown · Then that trip is not offered as a target

requirements.title: Block duplicate Guide suggestions on one checklist
requirements.story: As a traveller, I want the app to stop me adding the same Guide suggestion twice to one trip, so that my checklist has no repeated items.
ac: Given a trip's checklist already contains an item added from suggestion X · When I add suggestion X to the same trip again · Then no second item is created and I see a message that it is already on the checklist
Given suggestion X is already on trip A's checklist · When I add suggestion X to trip B · Then the item is added to trip B
Given I renamed the item that came from suggestion X · When I add suggestion X to the same trip again · Then it is still treated as a duplicate

requirements.title: Confirmation and clear error when adding a suggestion
requirements.story: As a traveller, I want to be told whether my suggestion was added or why it failed, so that I know the state of my checklist.
ac: Given the add succeeds · When the item is saved · Then I see a confirmation naming the trip within the same screen and the suggestion's action changes to an 'Added' state

Given the add cannot be saved (for example the device is offline or the save is rejected) · When I activate 'Add to checklist' · Then I see an error message that states the item was not added and what I can do next, and no item appears on the checklist
Given an error occurred · When I activate 'Add to checklist' again after the cause is fixed · Then the item is added once

requirements.title: Admin sees how many Guide suggestions are added to checklists
requirements.story: As an Admin, I want to see how many Guide suggestions travellers add to checklists, so that the team can tell whether Guides help people plan and keep using the app.
ac: Given travellers have added Guide suggestions · When an Admin opens Insights · Then the total number of suggestions added is shown for a selectable period (last 7 days, last 30 days, all time)
Given a suggestion add is blocked as a duplicate or fails with an error · When the count is calculated · Then that attempt is not counted
Given a user without Insights permission · When they open the admin area · Then they cannot see the count

requirements.title: Admin count by Guide without personal data
requirements.story: As an Admin, I want the count broken down by Guide while hiding who added what, so that we learn which Guides work without exposing individual travellers.
ac: Given suggestions were added from several Guides · When an Admin views the count · Then each Guide is listed with its number of adds
Given the stored count data · When it is inspected or exported · Then it contains no user id, name, email or trip id, only Guide, date and count
Given a Guide has no adds in the period · When the Admin views the list · Then that Guide is shown with a count of 0

requirements.title: Make 'Add to checklist' visible on every Guide suggestion
requirements.story: As a traveller reading a Guide, I want to see the 'Add to checklist' action next to each suggestion, so that I find it without searching.
ac: Given I open a Guide that has suggestions · When the page loads · Then each suggestion shows an 'Add to checklist' action without opening any menu

Given I use only a keyboard or a screen reader · When I move through a suggestion · Then the action can be reached and activated by keyboard and has an accessible name that includes the suggestion text (REQ-025 baseline)
